title: Chat template compatibility gating and onboarding checklist for model bundles
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: When new model bundles are onboarded we frequently encounter mismatches between the model's tokenization behaviour and Redwood's canonical chat templates. These mismatches manifest as broken role delimiters, off-by-one token counts in prompt length calculations, or unexpected subtoken splits inside user/system markers. This ticket implements a proactive compatibility gating step in the onboarding pipeline that validates templates against the model's tokenizer profile and provides automated, auditable fallback strategies to avoid rollout regressions.

Goals:
- Add a deterministic onboarding admission check that validates chat template delimiter alignment with the model tokenizer (role markers, newline/whitespace treatment, escape sequences).
- Offer three gating modes: hard-fail (block onboarding), soft-fail (allow onboarding but flag and attach remediation suggestions), and auto-fix (apply conservative template transforms with audit trail).
- Publish a human-readable compatibility report and a machine-readable profile (tokenizer quirks, preferred delimiter encoding, safe prefix/suffix trimming rules) to the model performance profile store.
- Wire telemetry and regression alerts so that onboarding teams can catch downstream runtime regressions tied to template incompatibility.

Non-goals:
- Rewriting tokenizer internals; this ticket focuses on admission and mitigation during onboarding.
- Full automated template rewrite for all edge-cases; auto-fix is intentionally conservative and opt-in.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding pipeline includes a template-tokenizer compatibility step that runs for every new model bundle.
The compatibility step outputs a JSON profile to the profile store with fields: canonical_delimiter, observed_split_behaviour, safe_prefix_trim_bytes, suggested_template_adjustments.
Gating modes are selectable via the onboarding UI/API and default to soft-fail for self-serve signups and hard-fail for enterprise-managed bundles.
All detected incompatibilities produce a human-friendly checklist for PMs/designers and an automated GitHub PR template for repo-based template fixes.
Telemetry: a dashboard charting the number of template adjustments applied and false-positive rate over a 2-week rolling window is available in Console.
implementation_notes: Phase 1: Add tokenizer probe that runs representative prompt fragments (role markers, nested escapes, trailing whitespace) and records token boundaries and counts.
Phase 2: Implement template validation rules using a pluggable rules engine (rules expressed as regex-like token sequence expectations) and surface per-rule results in the report.
Phase 3: Integrate with onboarding API to mark model bundle with compatibility state and attach suggested transform scripts (Python snippets) in the profile store.
Edge cases: multilingual tokenizers with non‑whitespace script boundaries will be flagged; acceptability thresholds configurable per-customer in Dedicated/Private modes.
We will not change existing pinned models retroactively; only new onboardings and re-pinning flows will run the gate until proven stable.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Over-eager hard-fail blocks large numbers of valid models. Mitigation: soft-fail default, rollout hard-fail only for vetted enterprise flows.
Risk: Inaccurate auto-fix could alter prompt semantics. Mitigation: auto-fix produces diff + canary rollout test that runs eval prompts before full publish.
Risk: Increased onboarding latency. Mitigation: tokenization probes are lightweight (<200ms per sample) and run in parallel with model metadata extraction.
rollout_plan: Week 1: Feature flag gated in staging; run compatibility checks for all incoming test bundles and write profiles to dev profile store.
Week 2: Expose soft-fail results to onboarding UI for internal teams; collect false-positive feedback and refine ruleset.
Week 3: Open soft-fail for public self-serve; pilot auto-fix with 2 partner customers under a controlled canary.
Week 4: Enable hard-fail behind enterprise policy toggle and document escalation path with Support and SE teams.
